rule: Every observed or plausible surface must have an explicit disposition; absence from active collection is not equivalent to irrelevance.

entries.rationale: Full ART/dex2oat tuning is useful for compilation-state analysis but too broad for the neutral baseline dump.
entries.falsifier: A stability incident correlates with JIT/AOT or dexopt state but the required ART property is absent.
entries.next_gate: Add a separate ART compilation profile only when the investigation is compiler/runtime specific.

entries.rationale: Low-memory lifecycle is central to target survival, but kill causality requires independent kernel/lmkd evidence.
entries.falsifier: A kill is attributed to LMKD from these properties alone.
entries.next_gate: Physical correlation with lmkd/log/kernel evidence and memory-pressure snapshot.

entries.rationale: Directly selects the expected SharedMemory backend contract on this Android 10 firmware.
entries.falsifier: Physical SharedMemory receipt demonstrates a different backend/lifetime assumption.
entries.next_gate: FD handoff + dual-process mapping + target restart survival.

entries.rationale: Defines trust/debug boundary and prevents hidden dependence on unlocked/rooted behavior.
entries.falsifier: Runtime behavior requires a privilege not available under the recorded boot contract.
entries.next_gate: Keep physical tests on locked production state unless a separate explicitly labeled lab state is used.

entries.rationale: FBE is relevant to checkpoint availability across reboot/unlock; per-user CE state is temporal and should be captured only for reboot-recovery studies.
entries.falsifier: Checkpoint recovery is claimed pre-unlock without DE/CE evidence.
entries.next_gate: Dedicated boot/reboot checkpoint experiment with CE/DE location typed.

entries.rationale: Build/slot topology is relevant to reproducibility, while dm device numbers are transient implementation details.
entries.falsifier: Two receipts from different slots/builds are compared as identical platform runs.
entries.next_gate: Bind slot/build into OTA regression receipts.

entries.rationale: These are independent crash/trace evidence producers; existence does not prove app access or causality.
entries.falsifier: Crash root cause is inferred from service-running state.
entries.next_gate: Correlate a reproducible crash with authorized tombstone/AEE/trace artifact hashes and timestamps.

entries.rationale: A property dump cannot prove an SELinux denial caused a failure.
entries.falsifier: Permission failure is labeled SELinux without an AVC/policy source.
entries.next_gate: Ingest sanitized denial metadata only when a denial is observed.

entries.rationale: Hundreds of tag levels are configuration noise for baseline recognition but useful during subsystem-specific debugging.
entries.falsifier: A reproducible issue requires a tag level that was not recorded for the targeted subsystem.
entries.next_gate: Generate a narrow log-profile overlay per investigation; never ingest all log content by default.

entries.rationale: Contains subscriber, operator and provisioning data; unrelated to general runtime stability baseline.
entries.falsifier: A radio-specific investigation cannot proceed without a non-identifying radio capability field.
entries.next_gate: Create a separate privacy-reviewed radio profile with capability/state only, never subscriber identity.

entries.rationale: Useful for connectivity-driver incidents, not baseline app runtime stability.
entries.falsifier: Connectivity crash/latency investigation lacks firmware/driver context.
entries.next_gate: Subsystem-specific connectivity profile with firmware version and driver readiness only.

entries.rationale: Service presence is not capability/performance evidence; relevant only when workload crosses those pipelines.
entries.falsifier: Graphics/media incident is analyzed without identifying the active backend/service surface.
entries.next_gate: Dedicated graphics/media profile with capability tests and frame/buffer timing.

entries.rationale: Thermal/power state can materially change latency and kill behavior but requires measured time-aligned values, not service presence alone.
entries.falsifier: Performance stability claim is made without thermal/power context.
entries.next_gate: Capture temperature/frequency/power context in physical benchmark/kill experiments.

entries.rationale: Network topology is dynamic and can add noise/privacy to a neutral baseline.
entries.falsifier: Network-dependent failure is investigated without transport state.
entries.next_gate: Opt-in network profile with interface/type/latency only and no identifiers/payload.

entries.rationale: Not required to reproduce the technical platform and creates unnecessary correlation risk.
entries.falsifier: A proposed workflow claims these identifiers are technically required for stability classification.
entries.next_gate: Use session-scoped non-reversible correlation only if a multi-device experiment truly needs disambiguation.

entries.rationale: Semantics may be undocumented and contents may be identifying or secret.
entries.falsifier: A field is promoted based only on name or apparent encoding.
entries.next_gate: Require vendor documentation or controlled experiment before typing meaning.

entries.rationale: Empty/configured properties and running services do not prove Vulkan/compute capability.
entries.falsifier: An independent Vulkan capability/functional test succeeds.
entries.next_gate: Promote only after an explicit capability receipt.

entries.rationale: CPU model hints do not replace HWCAP or executed SIMD proof.
entries.falsifier: HWCAP/selftest contradicts the model-derived expectation.
entries.next_gate: Keep capability receipt separate from platform metadata.

entries.rationale: High privacy/volume/observer cost and weak causal value for the neutral stability layer.
entries.falsifier: A narrowly scoped authorized crash experiment requires a specific byte range to falsify a memory-corruption hypothesis.
entries.next_gate: Use a separate opt-in forensic capture with address/range minimization and explicit retention.

entries.rationale: Can create self-interference and volume without evidence that cadence is informative.
entries.falsifier: A physical experiment shows event-driven/on-demand capture misses a required transient that a bounded cadence catches with acceptable overhead.
entries.next_gate: If needed, introduce adaptive bounded polling with measured observer cost, never silent default polling.

entries.rationale: ApplicationExitInfo process-death reason APIs start at Android API 30; the physical target is API 29.
entries.falsifier: Target API level is upgraded to >=30 and the API becomes available with usable history.
entries.next_gate: On API29 use independent lmkd/kernel/tombstone/log evidence; add ApplicationExitInfo only on a separately typed API30+ target.

entries.rationale: Frida-created resources may be cloaked from introspection, so target thread/range census cannot be treated as a complete measurement of observer overhead.
entries.falsifier: Instrumentation overhead is claimed zero or fully represented by target census alone.
entries.next_gate: Measure external process PSS/duration and compare instrumented vs control runs on device.

entries.rationale: Register snapshots are high-value near a fault but noisy and timing-sensitive for neutral periodic stability capture.
entries.falsifier: A reproducible native failure cannot be localized without register state at the causal boundary.
entries.next_gate: Add opt-in PRE_CRASH/POST_CRASH register-tail capture with strict event budget and thread selection.

entries.rationale: Instruction/call tracing can reconstruct causal paths but has substantially higher observer cost than the neutral dump.
entries.falsifier: Snapshot + event observers fail to distinguish competing control-flow hypotheses.
entries.next_gate: Opt-in bounded Stalker window around a pre-registered function/thread with measured overhead and exclusion ranges.

entries.rationale: Precise for targeted hypotheses but changes timing and is unsuitable as always-on baseline telemetry.
entries.falsifier: A specific address/state transition remains ambiguous after passive observation.
entries.next_gate: Use targeted authorized lab breakpoint/watchpoint with instrumentation-effect receipt.

entries.rationale: Logical-to-native method mapping is required for cross-layer causal debugging but is a separate symbolization/indexing problem.
entries.falsifier: A Java-visible failure cannot be reconciled with its native/JIT location.
entries.next_gate: Create correlation IDs DEX method -> ART method -> native code range using authorized app symbols/build artifacts.

entries.rationale: JNI is a key causal bridge but broad hooking would add noise and overhead.
entries.falsifier: A failure crosses managed/native boundary and causal order cannot be reconstructed.
entries.next_gate: Opt-in JNI boundary profile for pre-registered methods/classes with timestamp/thread correlation.

entries.rationale: Module name+size recognizes a surface but does not establish binary identity.
entries.falsifier: Two distinct ELF binaries share name+size or a module change requires exact artifact provenance.
entries.next_gate: Bind module to build-id/SHA-256 from authorized artifact or on-device file metadata where permission allows.

entries.rationale: Exception streams are valuable causal events but can be extremely high-volume and may contain application text.
entries.falsifier: A managed failure cannot be related to runtime state without exception type/timing.
entries.next_gate: Capture exception class + thread + sanitized stack hash only for an opt-in causal-tail profile.

entries.rationale: A process exception handler may affect fault propagation if misused; neutral stability sensing must not swallow or alter crashes.
entries.falsifier: Native crash correlation requires pre-tombstone fault metadata unavailable elsewhere.
entries.next_gate: If added, observe-and-forward only; never suppress the original fault; verify tombstone behavior remains unchanged.

entries.rationale: Broad value scanning is not a general stability signal and increases privacy/observer cost; useful only for a specific authorized hypothesis.
entries.falsifier: A pre-registered lab hypothesis is explicitly about locating a known synthetic sentinel/value.
entries.next_gate: Use narrow bounded scan in owned lab memory only, outside the default stability collector.

entries.rationale: Fault injection is useful to test recovery invariants but is an active perturbation, not observation.
entries.falsifier: Recovery behavior cannot be falsified without a controlled corruption stimulus.
entries.next_gate: Separate destructive lab mode with known target byte, pre/post hashes, rollback and no production-data target.

entries.rationale: Patching changes the system under test and would invalidate neutral stability evidence if mixed into the baseline mode.
entries.falsifier: A separately authorized remediation experiment explicitly tests one reversible patch.
entries.next_gate: Keep patching in a separate mutation lane with before/after artifact hashes and rollback receipt.

entries.rationale: No evidence in the current Android/MTK target establishes a meaningful NUMA topology for this app-runtime investigation.
entries.falsifier: Kernel/device evidence exposes multiple NUMA nodes affecting allocation/latency.
entries.next_gate: Do not add NUMA complexity until physical topology evidence exists.

entries.rationale: Queue saturation can cause latency/loss but generic queue introspection is subsystem-specific.
entries.falsifier: A failure correlates with backlog/overflow and the relevant queue has an observable bounded interface.
entries.next_gate: Add queue depth/drop counters only to the subsystem-specific profile that owns the queue.
